facts.text: I am planning a road trip soon.
I recently got my car serviced at the dealership on the 15th of last month.
The dealership replaced my brake pads.
The brake pads replacement cost around $350.
I want a new car cover to protect my car's paint job from the sun and rain.
I am considering a car cover with a waterproof layer and UV protection.
The car cover I am eyeing costs $120.
I use my phone's GPS navigation system to get to my kids' soccer practice every Saturday morning.
I am thinking of selling my old car seat that my kids have outgrown.
I want to put the money toward a new bike rack for my car.
I am thinking of getting a bike rack that attaches to the tow hitch.
The bike rack I am eyeing costs $250.
